hero.title: Forward Deployed Engineer Roadmap
hero.subtitle: Work at the intersection of customer, product, engineering and AI. 10 stages — click any stage to jump.

phases.label: Weeks 1-6 · 30 h
phases.detail: Steps 1-2: Python and AI engineering foundations

phases.label: Weeks 11-12 · 10 h
phases.detail: Step 10: Ecommerce Multi RAG agent capstone

capabilities: Write Python apps and a cited FAQ chat helper (RAG)
Talk to a customer and write a one-page requirements note
Sketch screens and a reference architecture diagram
Develop and test a retail Ask IT build with a regression question set
Deploy to Render or AWS with secrets in env, Langfuse, and a runbook
Answer basic IT safety questions and hand the project over clearly

faq.question: How long does this roadmap take?
faq.answer: 12 weeks at 1 hour a day, 5 days a week — about 60 hours total. Move on when you meet each stage's "ready to move on" checkpoint, not only when the week band ends.

faq.question: What does the roadmap cover?
faq.answer: Ten stages: Software Engineering (Python), AI Engineering (LLMs, RAG, agents, MCP), FDE SDLC (business requirements, UI/UX, architecture), Development, MVP/POC (local and Render validation), Production deployment, Enterprise AI FDE, and Capstone Project. Stages 3–9 use a retail company Ask IT case; Stage 10 is the Ecommerce Multi RAG agent capstone (three modules).

faq.question: What will I be able to do after?
faq.answer: Stand up apps and RAG prototypes, run discovery, develop and test customer solutions, deploy to Render or AWS, use Langfuse for evals, communicate with IT and sponsors, and deliver the Ecommerce Multi RAG agent capstone.

faq.question: How should I split my time?
faq.answer: Week 1 is Python (step 1) and Weeks 2–6 are AI engineering (step 2). Weeks 7–10 cover FDE SDLC through enterprise handover (steps 3–9). Weeks 11–12 are the Ecommerce Multi RAG agent capstone (step 10).

faq.question: What should I build to prove readiness?
faq.answer: Complete the three capstone modules: Ecommerce Full stack, Ecommerce Multi Agent, and Ecommerce Agentic RAG, with module acceptance criteria and handover notes (including Langfuse where applicable).

faq.question: Is progress saved? Do I need an account?
faq.answer: Progress is saved in your browser (localStorage). No login or backend is required for the FDE roadmap.

capstone.title: Capstone: Ecommerce Multi RAG agent
capstone.intro: Three-module capstone on React, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL: Ecommerce Full stack, then Ecommerce Multi Agent (LangGraph, live store tools), then Ecommerce Agentic RAG (FAISS, citations)—isolated backend packages and Langfuse for AI modules.
deliverables: Module 1: Ecommerce Full stack (catalog, cart, checkout, PostgreSQL)
Module 2: Ecommerce Multi Agent (agents/multi_agent/, scoped tools, Langfuse)
Module 3: Ecommerce Agentic RAG (agents/agentic_rag/, FAISS, citations)

strongWork.title: Commerce validated first
strongWork.body: Checkout and order persistence are tested before AI modules are accepted.

strongWork.title: Module boundaries
strongWork.body: Multi-agent and agentic RAG code paths are isolated; RAG does not perform cart or order writes.

strongWork.title: Shared platform
strongWork.body: Single FastAPI service, one React client, one PostgreSQL database, Langfuse on both AI modules.

strongWork.title: Documented evaluation
strongWork.body: Scripted store and RAG question sets with recorded scores; module handover notes state limits.
